notes.title: Letter From The Developer
notes.notes: [p]Hello! [/p][p]I've recently been adding game mechanics that will be necessary for transitioning from one level to another. The one I am most excited about is the addition of the Dropship vehicle which will play a critical role in the story. I had a blast putting it together! Here's a video of the most recent test flight after I got the engines working properly:  [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/vQfI7XvSxWI?si=HAnm5QpjfpRNeHeo"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]All but the character vocals were recorded in one continuous shot in the Unreal Editor so the FPS may be a little lower than it will be in the packaged version. [/p][p][/p][p]I wish you all the best,[/p][p][/p][p]  -Ron Mc.[/p]

notes.title: Letter From The Developer
notes.notes:
[p]Hello! [/p][p]Progress continues with updates to NPC animals, mission locations, and UI tweaks. Loading screens are now also being implemented when transitioning from one level to another (which I have found is much harder to do than I originally thought!). Not mentioned in the video, were necessary changes to the aiming/bullet system. Bullets now go where they are supposed to go when aiming :) 

[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/e354CRd3qVY"][/dynamiclink]

Thank you again for joining me on this journey and I look forward to sharing more content as it becomes available.

-Ron Mc.[/p]

notes.title: Letter From the Developer
notes.notes:
Hello! 

Recently, progress has been made on implementing the photography mechanic, which plays a pivotal role in unfolding the story. The first time Sara photographs an animal or a landmark, her journal will update, revealing certain story elements as well as her thoughts and feelings. This way, her character can really come to life and become an immersive tale.

Also, a "screenshot mode" has also been implemented that will allow the player to take screenshots from unique perspectives as they journey through the world.

For more information, check out the latest DevLog video!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mide2vWCs0o

Thank you again for joining me on this journey and I look forward to sharing more content as it becomes available.

-Ron Mc.

notes.title: Letter From the Developer
notes.notes:
Hello! 

Over the last several weeks, focus has been on updating the environment visuals while also enhancing performance. Previously, certain textures and static meshes were hindering performance and lowering FPS. Now, not only has FPS been restored to 60+ FPS (in the Unreal Editor), but it was also done in a way that allowed for greatly increased detail to all foliage actors. The result is a much smoother experience and more enjoyable gameplay. 

Check out the latest DevLog video!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gfcbXlRLsqQ

Thank you again for joining me on this journey and I look forward to sharing more content as it becomes available.

-Ron Mc.

notes.title: Letter From the Developer
notes.notes:
Hello! 

Thank you again for all of the support! I am excited to share with you what I've been working on.

Recently I've made quite a bit of progress fixing various bugs that I've been putting off:

1. Weapons: Fixed a problem with reloading (reload animation would play even if the player was out of ammo).

2. Camera View: Fixed a problem with the camera being jerked around when transitioning from different events (i.e. landing with a parachute caused the camera to shake wildly).

3. Traversal: Fixed a problem where the player's ability to climb walls wasn't working.

In addition to these fixes, a ton of progress was made in regard to world building. Specifically, the opening cinematic has been added which lays out the backstory leading up to Sara's adventure and the events of "Edge of the Wild". 

Here's a sneak-peak image from the opening cinematic:
[url=https://www.avalonstudios.org/development-progress][img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/66b93433e70da415147ad691/8af743b4-c473-4ecc-b76f-734e48fb26ab/Dropship_Takeoff.png?format=2500w[/img][/url]


 Thank you again for joining me on this journey and I look forward to sharing more content as it becomes available.

-Ron Mc.

notes.title: Letter From the Developer

Visit:

notes.title: Letter from the Developer
notes.notes:
Hello,

I am the owner of Avalon Studios and the developer of the upcoming game "Edge of the Wild". I am excited to announce the development of this project and invite you to follow it's progress as I continue to add new features and content. I hope to deliver a single-player experience that is fun and satisfying for anyone who loves exploring the outdoors. My goal is to capture the beauty of the natural world in a way that inspires others to go out there and explore the world around them and experience all of it's mysteries, dangers, and magnificence. I hope you join me on this journey!

I look forward to sharing more content with you as it becomes available.

Thank you,
-Ron Mc.
